articles.title: CM Punk Reflects on WWE Return Anniversary, Logan Paul Return Advertised, TNA Rumors on Hardy Boyz
articles.summary: Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.
articles.body:
Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.

Three years after making his shocking WWE return at Survivor Series 2023, CM Punk reflected on what the past three years have been like leading up to Survivor Series 2026.

During an appearance this week on the Rich Eisen Show (h/t WrestlePurists ), Punk gave a positive outlook on his second stint with WWE after initially leaving way back in 2014:

"Time of my life, and I think in those three years, I've done the best work of my entire career," Punk said. "To me, I'm showing no signs of slowing down. I'm exactly where I want to be. The company's a different place than it was when I left. As Seth [Rollins] likes to constantly say, took my ball and went home, to in turn make things better for all of the boys, himself included.

"I think I've been doing the best work of my career and it's been a dream come true. I really don't have a bad thing to say about my time back except for the fact that I have to tag with Seth Rollins on Saturday at Survivor Series."

Punk's brief run with AEW ended in 2023 when he got released by the company, and at that point, it seemed like his wrestling career may be over for good.

However, Punk surprised many by showing up at the end of Survivor Series 2023, which was held in his hometown of Survivor Series.

Since then, Punk has taken part in some of the best rivalries and matches of his career, and he has achieved numerous accolades, including two World Heavyweight Championship reigns and one reign as WWE champion.

At Survivor Series on Saturday, Punk will be part of the Team USA vs. Team Mexico five-on-five elimination match.

Punk was blindsided this week on Raw when Cody Rhodes named Rollins the final member of Team USA, building up some much-needed tension ahead of the match given the long-running issues between Punk and Rhodes.

With the road to WrestleMania creeping ever closer, Survivor Series could mark the start of the build toward Punk's WrestleMania match, potentially against Rhodes, Rollins or even both, which would add to the impressive catalog of matches he has had since returning to WWE.

Paul Advertised to Make WWE In-Ring Return

After being on the shelf for the past six months, it appears as though Logan Paul's in-ring hiatus may soon be coming to an end.

On Wednesday, the official X account for Madison Square Garden in New York City announced that Paul will be "in action" as part of the WWE Holiday Live Tour on Dec. 26:

Paul suffered a torn triceps back in May during a World Tag Team Championship defense pitting him and Austin Theory against The Street Profits.

While Paul and Theory successfully defended their titles at Saturday Night's Main Event, Paul got injured during the latter stages of the match, and it required surgery.

He has continued to appear on Raw in the months since the injury, but it has been in a non-physical role with him limited to cutting promos and causing mischief outside the ring during The Vision's matches.

Since another Vision member in Bronson Reed is currently out injured as well, getting Paul back into the fold over the next month will be huge in terms of strengthening the stable.

The Dec. 26 event at MSG is an untelevised house show, and if that marks Paul's first match after returning, it could be the perfect opportunity to get him back in ring shape ahead of major events like Royal Rumble.

Latest on Hardy Boyz' TNA Contract Situation

Matt and Jeff Hardy reportedly may soon be free to sign wherever they please as free agents.

According to Fightful Wrestling , the Hardys' TNA contracts are set to expire "soon."

The Hardy Boyz have enjoyed multiple stints in TNA, and their current one began after both of them departed AEW in 2024.

Matt was the first to arrive in April 2024, and Jeff wasn't far behind, reuniting with his brother a couple of months later.

The Hardys have enjoyed a great deal of success during their latest TNA tenure, holding the TNA World Tag Team Championships three times, thus making them five-time TNA world tag team champions overall.

Since returning to TNA in 2024, The Hardy Boyz have also made numerous appearances in WWE, and they even held the NXT Tag Team Championships for a few weeks in October 2025.

The Hardys' WWE appearances have been limited to NXT over the past couple of years, though, and it is fair to wonder if there is any desire on their part to re-sign with WWE and have one final run on Raw and SmackDown.

Re-signing with TNA could still allow Matt and Jeff to work with WWE due to the partnership between the two companies, but returning to WWE officially would be a full-circle moment and the perfect opportunity for WWE to award them their rightful spot in the WWE Hall of Fame.

articles.title: Trinity Rodman misses USWNT tournament with shoulder injury amid reported separation from tennis star Ben Shelton
articles.summary: Trinity Rodman will miss the United States women's national team's upcoming CONCACAF W Championship after suffering a minor shoulder injury.
articles.body: Trinity Rodman will miss the United States women's national team's upcoming CONCACAF W Championship after suffering a minor shoulder injury. US Soccer confirmed her withdrawal on November 24 and named Gotham FC forward Jaedyn Shaw as her replacement. The news came just hours after reports claimed that Rodman and tennis star Ben Shelton had ended their relationship after nearly two years together. Neither athlete has publicly confirmed the reported split. Rodman's injury dates back to the Washington Spirit's 2-1 defeat to Kansas City Current in the NWSL Championship on November 21.Trinity Rodman's Shoulder Injury Rules Her Out as Jaedyn Shaw Takes Her USWNT SpotUS Soccer confirmed that Rodman picked up the injury during the NWSL Championship game. The forward was hurt in the opening minutes after a collision with Kansas City Current defender Laney Rouse. Despite the problem, she returned to the field and stayed in the game.The 24-year-old even scored Washington's only goal in stoppage time, but it was not enough to prevent a 2-1 defeat. The loss also ended the Spirit's hopes of winning the NWSL title.Following the injury, USWNT head coach Emma Hayes brought in Jaedyn Shaw to replace Rodman for the 2026 CONCACAF W Championship. The Gotham FC forward has already made 37 appearances for the national team and scored 10 goals.The tournament is important for the United States as it also serves as qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. The four quarterfinal winners will earn direct places in the tournament. The competition will also decide the CONCACAF teams for the 2028 Olympic Games.According to the Associated Press, the United States will face El Salvador in its quarterfinal on Friday in Mansfield, Texas.Ben Shelton and Trinity Rodman Reportedly End Relationship After Busy Sporting SchedulesRodman's withdrawal came hours after the Daily Mail reported that she and Ben Shelton had separated. The report claimed that their demanding careers and frequent travel made it difficult to spend enough time together. However, the two are reportedly still on good terms.The couple made their relationship public in March 2025 after months of speculation. Since then, they have often travelled to support each other at major sporting events.Rodman was regularly seen cheering for Shelton during his tennis matches. She also attended Wimbledon in 2025 and supported him during his run at the 2026 US Open. At the same time, Shelton also made efforts to attend Rodman's soccer matches.However, their schedules became harder to manage as both athletes continued to travel for their respective sports.Shelton had spoken about this problem in a September interview with Us Weekly. He explained that finding time for each other was not always easy, even when they had a few days away from competition."It is really difficult," Shelton said.He also explained that both athletes were often too tired to make plans after finishing their tournaments."Sometimes I leave these tournaments and I'm a bit of a zombie. I'm not the most fun person to be around," he said.Shelton added that both were still working towards their biggest career goals. articles.title: OSSAA schools approve recruiting and summer participation rule changes
articles.summary: OSSAA member schools approved two rule changes that address summer participation and recruiting violation, it was announced Wednesday.
articles.body:
Oklahoma Secondary School Activities Association member schools approved two rule changes that address summer participation and recruiting violations, the OSSAA announced Wednesday.

The votes included revisions to Rule 7 and Rule 9.

The change to Rule 7 will take effect at the end of the school year and has to do with summer participation.

It is essentially in place to prevent athletes from scouting a program. Now, participating in summer activities will play a role in determining whether an athlete is tied to that school. If they are, their ability to transfer will be limited.

Certain things — such as weightlifting, strength and conditioning, individual skill camps and spring football — will not count as participation.

The Rule 9 change will take effect on July 1 and is related to the recruitment of athletes.

A committee will now review complaints and hold hearings to determine if violations have occurred.

Coaches who are guilty of recruiting violations will be suspended for 365 days, and athletic programs will be given a one-year warning. Repeated violations for a program will result in more consequences.

"Our dedicated Rule Review Committee has expedited a lot of positive changes," OSSAA executive director David Jackson said in a release. "It's yet another avenue in which we're having in-depth conversations with school leaders to ensure OSSAA is serving students to the best of its ability and setting us up to be more adaptable for years to come."

articles.title: Week 12 Fantasy Football Injury Report: The Latest Update On Bhayshul Tuten, Derrick Henry, And All The Stars
articles.summary: The latest injury updates on all the top fantasy football stars in Week 12.
articles.body:
It's Wednesday, and as always, that means it's time for our first fantasy football injury report of the week. It will be key to check these out and read them closely, because the holiday schedule gives us five games to worry about before we even reach the weekend. This is our mid-week fantasy football injury report for Week 12.

Purdy missed practice on Wednesday due to a sprained ankle. We don't expect him to be in danger of missing Week 12, but this is worth monitoring just in case.

Coming off the Seahawks' Week 11 bye, Darnold is expected to return to action and reclaim his starting job from Drew Lock. He is a slight upgrade over Lock.

Herbert is in the concussion protocol and was not able to practice on Wednesday. You shouldn't be starting Herbert even if he is cleared, but somehow it seems like it would be even worse for the Chargers' weapons if Herbert can't play.

RB Kenneth Walker III, Kansas City Chiefs

Walker has once again been ruled out for the Chiefs on a short week. It will be wheels up for rookie Emmett Johnson again this week.

Henry has been placed in the league's concussion protocol. While the team is expecting him to play this week, he will have to clear the protocol before he's allowed out there. Justice Hill would be the next man up.

Tuten did not practice on Wednesday due to his ankle injury, and he could be shaping up to be a game-time decision this week. Monitor this situation closely. Chris Rodriguez is the next man up.

Marks is back at practice after missing last week due to a concussion. With David Montgomery now back, it will be interesting to see how this backfield plays out. We expect Marks to lead the backfield.

McMillan is dealing with a foot injury, but is expected to play this week. However, his practice status should be monitored throughout the week.

After missing the past few games with a hamstring injury, Harrison was back at practice on Wednesday. He still has not been fully integrated into the Texans' offense after getting injured so quickly after the trade.

WR Michael Pittman Jr, Pittsburgh Steelers

Pittman is once again practicing on Wednesday and is expected to return from IR this week.

Ferguson has been ruled out for Thanksgiving and will miss Week 12.

Kincaid should once again be considered questionable for Week 12 and could go either way after missing Week 11. Dawson Knox will see more work if Kincaid can't go.
